Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots and documenting all findings.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The audit evaluated data freshness, data quality, navigation, UX, and the mobile experience. The site has an excellent mobile layout and visually consistent cards, but suffers from several critical data quality issues.

**Key Findings:**
1. **Critical Data Errors:** Multiple upcoming games show impossible 100%/0% probabilities (especially in prop markets), and some future MLB games are incorrectly labeled as "FINAL".
2. **Stale Data:** Featured markets on the Weather and Economics pages reference past dates (e.g., April 2026, Q1 2026).
3. **Broken Visualizations:** The Global Temperature Map and Fed Rate Heatmap fail to render, showing permanent loading skeletons.
4. **Grid Issues:** The NBA grid only shows 5 teams by default, and the NHL grid lists 33 teams (including both Arizona and Utah).

The full report with detailed findings, scoring, and actionable recommendations is attached, along with screenshots of the key pages and critical failures.
